title: Perfect Productivity Prompts
description: Prompt set to improve focus, planning, and output every day.
seoDescription: Use productivity prompts to plan work, prioritize tasks, and stay focused.

prompts.title: Daily Priority Planner
prompts.text: Create a priority plan for today from this task list: [tasks], using impact and urgency.

prompts.title: Deep Work Plan
prompts.text: Create a deep work schedule for [hours] today with breaks and distraction controls.

prompts.title: Decision Matrix
prompts.text: Build a weighted decision matrix for choosing between [option A] and [option B].

prompts.title: Weekly Reset
prompts.text: Generate a weekly review template with wins, blockers, lessons, and next-week priorities.

prompts.title: Email Compression
prompts.text: Summarize these emails and produce a reply plan with priorities: [emails].

body:
Prompt set to improve focus, planning, and output every day.

Daily Priority Planner

Plan highest-impact tasks quickly.

Create a priority plan for today from this task list: [tasks], using impact and urgency.

Deep Work Plan

Build focused work blocks.

Create a deep work schedule for [hours] today with breaks and distraction controls.

Decision Matrix

Compare options objectively.

Build a weighted decision matrix for choosing between [option A] and [option B].

Weekly Reset

Review performance and reset goals.

Generate a weekly review template with wins, blockers, lessons, and next-week priorities.

Email Compression

Reduce inbox overload.

Summarize these emails and produce a reply plan with priorities: [emails].
